title: Wild Kingdom
intro: [excited] Welcome in to a WILD episode of Disney Jeopardy! Tonight it is lions, sloths, rabbits and one very sassy hornbill. [laughs] Keep your hands inside the safari truck, because these clues BITE.

art.prompt: A golden African savanna at sunrise: acacia trees, a towering rocky outcrop, herds of zebras, elephants and giraffes, a giant baobab-like tree in the distance. Wide 16:9 composition, original painterly animated-film style artwork, no text, no logos, no recognizable copyrighted characters.

categories.title: Long Live the King
categories.intro: [excited] We begin on the African savanna with The Lion King. Remember who you are, and remember the answers too.

art.prompt: A towering rock outcrop jutting over a vast savanna at dawn, the sun rising behind it, birds in an orange sky. Wide 16:9 composition, original painterly animated-film style artwork, no text, no logos, no recognizable copyrighted characters.

clues.clue: Timon and Pumbaa teach Simba this Swahili phrase that means no worries.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is Hakuna Matata. It means no worries for the rest of your days. It is a problem-free philosophy.

clues.clue: Name the song that plays as the animals gather at Pride Rock in the opening scene, like the moment pictured.
choices: I Just Can't Wait to Be King
Can You Feel the Love Tonight
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Circle of Life, sung by Carmen Twillie with Lebo M on that famous opening chant. [sighs happily] Goosebumps... every single time.

clues.clue: Simba's mother, the queen of the Pride Lands, has this name.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is... Sarabi. Sarafina is Nala's mom, and Kiara is Simba's daughter in the sequel. So many lions, so many names.

clues.clue: Scar sings this villain song to the hyenas while they goose-step past him.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Be Prepared. [chuckles] Jeremy Irons threw out his voice during recording, so Jim Cummings finished the final verse.

clues.clue: An early working title for The Lion King wrongly placed its lions in this kind of habitat. Name the title.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is King of the Jungle. Then someone pointed out lions live on the savanna, not in the jungle. [laughs] Oops.

categories.title: Species Spotter
categories.intro: [mischievously] Next up is Species Spotter. I name a Disney animal sidekick, you tell me exactly what kind of creature it is.

art.prompt: A naturalist's field journal desk with binoculars, a magnifying glass, feathers, paw print casts and colorful animal sketches with no writing. Wide 16:9 composition, original painterly animated-film style artwork, no text, no logos, no recognizable copyrighted characters.

clues.clue: Sven, Kristoff's carrot-loving best buddy in Frozen, is this kind of animal.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is a reindeer. Reindeers are better than people. Kristoff said so, and Sven agreed.

clues.clue: Rapunzel's color-changing best friend Pascal is this kind of animal.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is a chameleon. He turns pink when he's mad. [laughs] Not exactly intimidating, Pascal.

clues.clue: Flit, Pocahontas's tiny, grumpy feathered friend, is this kind of bird.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is... a hummingbird. Small bird, big attitude. He and Meeko the raccoon bicker the whole film.

clues.clue: Benjamin Clawhauser, the donut-loving desk officer in Zootopia, is this kind of animal.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is a cheetah. [chuckles] The fastest land animal, and he spends his whole shift sitting at a desk. Relatable.

clues.clue: Mr. Big, Zootopia's tiny but feared crime boss, is this kind of animal.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is an arctic shrew. His big bodyguards are polar bears. Do not ice him, and definitely do not laugh.

categories.title: Rhyme in the Jungle
categories.intro: Time for Rhyme Time, animal edition. I give you two clues, and the answer is two rhyming words. Ready? Steady? [chuckles] Rhyme-y?

art.prompt: A lush jungle canopy with hanging vines forming swirling musical shapes, colorful parrots, monkeys and butterflies in silhouette. Wide 16:9 composition, original painterly animated-film style artwork, no text, no logos, no recognizable copyrighted characters.

clues.clue: The Jungle Book's laid-back bear plus a place full of animals in a city.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is Baloo zoo. He would not last a day. He would be out looking for the bare necessities.

clues.clue: The flying baby elephant plus a word for extra large.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Dumbo jumbo. Bonus fact, his mother is named Mrs. Jumbo. [laughs] So it really runs in the family.

clues.clue: The Lion King's lovable warthog plus a Cuban ballroom dance.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is... Pumbaa rumba. The rumba is all about swaying your hips, and Pumbaa was BUILT for it.

clues.clue: The Jungle Book's hypnotic python plus a place to get a massage.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Kaa spa. Trust in me, just relax. Then he tries to eat you. [sarcastic] Five stars, would not recommend.

clues.clue: Prince John's slithering royal adviser in Robin Hood plus a smooch.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Hiss kiss, as in Sir Hiss, voiced by Terry-Thomas. Prince John would never. He is too busy sucking his thumb.

categories.title: Party Animal Kingdom
categories.intro: To the parks we go, and only one park will do for a wild night. It is all about Disney's Animal Kingdom.

art.prompt: A giant sculpted tree covered in carved animal shapes rising over a lush theme park, a snowy Himalayan-style mountain and a safari truck in the distance. Wide 16:9 composition, original painterly animated-film style artwork, no text, no logos, no recognizable copyrighted characters.

clues.clue: This giant artificial tree at the heart of Animal Kingdom has more than 300 animals carved into it.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is the Tree of Life. It stands 145 feet tall. Try to spot all the animals and you'll be there until closing.

clues.clue: On this coaster, you race up a mountain, go BACKWARD in the dark and meet the Yeti.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Expedition Everest, Legend of the Forbidden Mountain. The Yeti says hello. [laughs] Loudly.

clues.clue: You climb into an open-air truck to see giraffes, lions and elephants on this African attraction.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is... Kilimanjaro Safaris. Every ride is different, because the animals don't follow a script. Unlike me.

clues.clue: Disney's Animal Kingdom opened on Earth Day in this year.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is 1998, on April 22nd. Earth Day, naturally. [laughs] Get it? Naturally?

clues.clue: This Africa walking trail, renamed Pangani Forest for nearly two decades, went back to its original name in 2016.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Gorilla Falls Exploration Trail. It was renamed Pangani in 1998, just months after opening, and switched back in 2016.

categories.title: Hear the Critter
categories.intro: [excited] The Club DJ members picked Hear the Critter. Our voice actor reads a famous animal line, you name the animal who said it.

art.prompt: A vintage studio microphone in the middle of a jungle clearing, surrounded by curious glowing animal eyes in the dark foliage. Wide 16:9 composition, original painterly animated-film style artwork, no text, no logos, no recognizable copyrighted characters.

clues.clue: Which animal character said this?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Dug, the talking golden retriever from Up. [excited] SQUIRREL! [clears throat] Sorry, where was I?
clues.quote: My name is Dug. I have just met you, and I love you.

clues.clue: Which animal character said this?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Thumper from Bambi, quoting his dad. [laughs] Honestly, solid advice for the comment section.
clues.quote: If you can't say something nice, don't say nothing at all.

clues.clue: Which animal character said this?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is... Mushu, voiced by Eddie Murphy in Mulan. Dishonor on you, dishonor on your cow!
clues.quote: Dishonor! Dishonor on your whole family!

clues.clue: Which animal character said this?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Stitch, Experiment 626, voiced by director Chris Sanders. [chuckles] Little and broken, but still good. Ohana means family.
clues.quote: This is my family. I found it, all on my own.

clues.clue: Which animal character said this?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Chief Bogo, the Cape buffalo, who then tells Judy to let it go. Idris Elba with the Frozen burn.
clues.quote: Life isn't some cartoon musical where you sing a little song.
